wargear.name: Flak jerkin
wargear.summary: A layered flak coat scavenged from the regiment's stores and kept for the sergeant.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Flak jerkin has a Save Characteristic of 4+, unless its Save Characteristic is already better.

wargear.name: Provost's greatcoat
wargear.summary: A heavy coat sewn with ward-plates and a hidden shield-belt, issued to officers the provosts cannot afford to lose.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Provost's greatcoat has an Invulnerable Save of 5+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Old Hand
wargear.summary: A sergeant who has survived three levies.
wargear.text: A Model upgraded to an Old Hand adds 1 to its Weapon Skill and Attacks Characteristics.

wargear.name: Regimental colours
wargear.summary: A tattered banner the whole muster would sooner die than lose.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with Regimental colours, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Leadership and Cool Characteristics.

wargear.name: Combat stimms
wargear.summary: Cheap injectors handed out before the whistle.
wargear.text: In any Battle Turn in which a Unit that was dosed with Combat stimms makes a Charge, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Strength Characteristic until the end of the Assault Phase.

wargear.name: Scrap-armour plates
wargear.summary: Girders, door panels and salvaged hull riveted on in the staging yard.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Scrap-armour plates adds 1 to its Hull Points Characteristic.

wargear.name: Salvaged gun shield
wargear.summary: A curved shield cut from a wrecked vehicle and bolted to the carriage.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Salvaged gun shield has a Save Characteristic of 3+, unless its Save Characteristic is already better.

wargear.name: Regimental drum
wargear.summary: A battered marching drum carried by the sergeant, setting the pace.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Regimental drum, all Models in that Unit have the Drumbeat March Special Rule.

wargear.name: Hive luck charms
wargear.summary: Hive-bred talismans of bone and wire that every veteran swears by.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Hive luck charms has the Feel No Pain (6+) and Hive Luck Special Rules.

wargear.name: Penal brand-iron
wargear.summary: A heated iron that marks cowards.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Penal brand-iron has the Penal Brand Special Rule.

wargear.name: Extra shell racks
wargear.summary: Spare ammunition crates stacked around the gun.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with Extra shell racks, all Models in that Unit have the Extra Shells Special Rule.

wargear.name: Scrap-iron ram-prow
wargear.summary: A ramming prow beaten out of girders and plate.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Scrap-iron ram-prow has the Hammer the Barricades Special Rule.

wargear.name: Witchbane charm-string
wargear.summary: Strings of knotted charms and sanctified bone, worn against the whispers.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Witchbane charm-string adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic and has the Witchbane Special Rule.

wargear.name: Handler's goad
wargear.summary: A cattle-prod and bullhorn that keeps the beasts on the move.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Handler's goad, all Models in that Unit have the Goaded Fury Special Rule.

modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

modifiers.text: Packed shoulder to shoulder: +1 LD, -1 I.
Hive luck charms: Hive Luck, Feel No Pain (6+).

rules.name: Riders of the Flank
rules.summary: The lords sweep wide to take the enemy line from the side.
rules.text: In a Battle Turn in which a Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule arrived from Reserves, add 2 to the result of its Charge Rolls.

rules.name: Human Wave
rules.summary: Empty the hab-blocks, hand out the rifles, and let the enemy run out of bullets first.
rules.text: While a Unit with this Special Rule includes ten or more Models, all Models in it add 1 to their Leadership and Cool Characteristics and the Unit automatically passes Panic Checks and Cool Checks made for Pinning. When a Unit with this Special Rule is destroyed in the Assault Phase, the enemy Unit that destroyed it cannot make a Consolidation move as a result.

rules.name: Home Turf
rules.summary: The gangs know every stairwell, drain and vent shaft on the battlefield.
rules.text: After both Players have deployed and before the first Battle Turn begins, each Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule may make a Set-up Move of up to 6". It cannot end that move within 9" of any enemy Model.

rules.name: Stampede
rules.summary: The handlers loose their charges and get out of the way.
rules.text: In any Battle Turn in which a Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule makes a Charge, add 2 to the result of its Charge Roll and add 1 to the Attacks Characteristic of all its Models until the end of the Assault Phase.

rules.name: Dug-In Guns
rules.summary: The battery is entrenched before the first shot.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule that did not move in its last Movement Phase adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic and has the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule against Shooting Attacks until it next moves.

rules.name: Drumbeat March
rules.summary: A battered marching drum sets the pace and nobody dares fall behind.
rules.text: When a Unit with this Special Rule Rushes, add 2" to the distance it may move.

rules.name: Hive Luck
rules.summary: Every veteran of the hive has a charm, and swears by it.
rules.text: Once per battle, when a Model with this Special Rule is allocated an Unsaved Wound, the Controlling Player may discard that Wound.

rules.name: Penal Brand
rules.summary: The mark of the coward is also the reminder to every man who sees it.
rules.text: All friendly Units within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule add 1 to their Cool Characteristic. Each time one of those Units fails a Cool Check, the Controlling Player must remove one Model from the Unit that includes the Model with this Special Rule as a casualty.

rules.name: Extra Shells
rules.summary: Spare ammunition crates stacked around the gun.
rules.text: Once per battle, a Unit with this Special Rule may add 2 to the Firepower of one of its Ranged Weapons for a single Shooting Attack.

rules.name: Hammer the Barricades
rules.summary: A prow of girders and plate that clears barricades and bodies alike.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule does not make Dangerous Terrain Tests for moving across Barricades. When it moves through an enemy Unit, that Unit suffers D3 additional Hits.

rules.name: Witchbane
rules.summary: Knotted charms and sanctified bone, worn against the whispers.
rules.text: A Psychic Power or Weapon with the Force (X) Special Rule that targets the Unit of a Model with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from the result of every Willpower Check made to use it.

rules.name: Goaded Fury
rules.summary: A cattle-prod and bullhorn that keeps the beasts on the move.
rules.text: While the Model with this Special Rule is in a Unit, that Unit adds 1 to the result of its Charge Rolls, and its Beast Models cannot gain the Pinned Tactical Status.

rites.name: The Feudal Host
rites.flavor: The lords of this world ride out in their grandfathers' armour and expect to be followed.

modifiers.text: The Feudal Host: Fast (1), Riders of the Flank.

require.note: Bring at least two mounted units.

rites.text: The lords of this world ride out in their grandfathers' armour and expect to be followed.
benefits: Militia Outriders (Cavalry Troops) and Mounted Command Troops may fill Troops slots and gain Fast (1).
They gain Riders of the Flank: they add 2 to their Charge Rolls in a Battle Turn in which they arrived from Reserves.
limitations: At least two Cavalry Troops or Mounted Command Troops are required.
No Fire Support, Field Gun, Heavy Ordnance or Rapier units, and no Explorator or Mining Rigs.
Table-top: a unit with Riders of the Flank that can charge must charge the nearest enemy it can reach.

rites.name: The Levy Tide
rites.flavor: Empty the hab-blocks, hand out the rifles, and let the enemy run out of bullets first.

modifiers.text: The Levy Tide: Line (1), Human Wave.

require.note: Bring at least three Levy Troops.

rites.text: Empty the hab-blocks, hand out the rifles, and let the enemy run out of bullets first.
benefits: They gain Human Wave: while a Levy Troop has ten or more Models it adds 1 to Leadership and Cool and automatically passes Panic Checks and Pinning Cool Checks, and a Levy Troop destroyed in the Assault Phase gives the enemy no Consolidation move.
limitations: At least three Levy Troops are required.
No more than one Infantry Troop.
No Elites, Armour or Lord of War units.

rites.name: Hive-Gang Muster
rites.flavor: They know every stairwell, drain and ventilation shaft better than any sector commander.

modifiers.text: Hive-Gang Muster: Move Through Cover, Home Turf.

require.note: Bring at least two gang units.

rites.text: They know every stairwell, drain and ventilation shaft better than any sector commander.
benefits: Grenadier Troops and Reconnaissance Troops may fill Troops slots.
Grenadiers gain Move Through Cover and Reconnaissance Troops gain Shrouded (5+).
Both gain Home Turf: a free 6" Set-up Move before the first Battle Turn, ending more than 9" from the enemy.
limitations: At least two Grenadier or Reconnaissance Troops are required.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units, and no Ogryn Brute Troops.

rites.name: The Abhuman Ranks
rites.flavor: What the Imperium will not mention in its histories, the Militia will march at the front.

modifiers.text: The Abhuman Ranks: Feel No Pain (6+), Stampede.

modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

require.note: Bring at least two abhuman or beast units.

rites.text: What the Imperium will not mention in its histories, the Militia will march at the front.
benefits: Ogryn Brute Troops and Beastmaster Troops may fill Troops slots.
Ogryn Brutes gain Feel No Pain (6+).
Both gain Stampede: +2 to Charge Rolls, and all their Models add 1 to Attacks in a Battle Turn in which they Charge.
limitations: At least two Ogryn Brute or Beastmaster Troops are required.
No Levy Troops and no more than one Infantry Troop.
Table-top: a unit with Stampede that can charge must charge the nearest enemy it can reach.

rites.name: The Siege Line
rites.flavor: Dig in, lay the guns, and let them come to you across open ground.

modifiers.condition: if the unit did not move in its last Movement phase

require.note: Provosts keep the gunners at their posts.

rites.text: Dig in, lay the guns, and let them come to you across open ground.
benefits: Field Gun Batteries, Heavy Ordnance Batteries, Fire Support Troops and Rapier Troops may fill Troops slots.
They gain Dug-In Guns: if they did not move in their last Movement Phase they add 1 to Ballistic Skill and have Shrouded (5+) against Shooting Attacks.
limitations: At least one Discipline Master Cadre is required.
No Recon, no Fast Attack and no Cavalry or Mounted Command Troops.

armyRules.name: Expendable Masses
armyRules.flavor: The hive has more bodies than rifles.
benefits: While a Unit with this Special Rule includes ten or more Models, all Models in it add 1 to their Cool Characteristic.
drawbacks: While a Unit with this Special Rule includes fewer than five Models, all Models in it subtract 1 from their Cool Characteristic.
armyRules.condition: while the unit has 10 or more models

armyRules.name: Summary Discipline
armyRules.flavor: Provosts keep the line by fear of the firing squad.
benefits: A Unit within 6" of a friendly Discipline Master automatically passes any Cool Check or Panic Check it is required to make.
drawbacks: Each time a Unit passes a check by this Special Rule that it would otherwise have failed, the Controlling Player must remove one Model from that Unit as a casualty, as an example to the rest.

armyRules.name: Desperate Courage
armyRules.flavor: Cornered militia fight harder than they should.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic in any Assault Phase in which its Unit was Charged, or while its Unit has half or fewer of its starting Models.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule may only Rush towards the nearest enemy Unit.
armyRules.condition: when charged, or at half strength or fewer
